The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 436M on revenue of 2,153M, ~20% margin) and strong capitalization (equity of 3,858M representing ~34% of total assets). However, liquidity is weak with a current ratio below 1 (current assets 674M vs. current liabilities 932M), and overall leverage is moderate-high (total liabilities of 7,452M vs. equity of 3,858M). Overall, this supports a lower-investment-grade rating.  
DECISION: BBB-
